userUrl.description: URL linking to contributor's profile page.

hasgoogleprofile.description: True if linked to a Google account profile.

location.description: Geographic location configured in author profile.

showaboutme.description: UI toggle for rendering the biography text.

showlocation.description: UI toggle for rendering the location string.

team.description: True if the blog has multiple authors and is configured as a team blog.

title.description: Widget header title (defaults to 'About Me' or 'Contributors' if omitted).

userUrl.description: URL linking to the author's public profile page.

photo.reason: Legacy photo model (`.url`, `.width`, `.height`, `.alt`). Replaced by `authorPhoto` in v2.

showaboutme.description: Toggle display of author 'About Me' biographical snippet.

showlocation.description: Toggle display of author geographical location.

ReportAbuse.description: System abuse reporting link gadget (DSA compliance, replaces legacy Navbar reporting channel).

Stats.description: Historical pageview counter, sparkline trend display flags, and stats endpoint URL.

showAnimatedCounter.description: UI toggle indicating whether digits animate dynamically on increment.

showGraphicalCounter.description: UI toggle indicating whether to render stylized graphical digit tiles.

showSparkline.description: UI toggle indicating whether to display the miniature traffic trend chart.

statsUrl.description: Blogger endpoint URL used to retrieve traffic counts and sparkline graphics.

title.description: Widget header title (defaults to 'Total Pageviews' if omitted).

showAnimatedCounter.description: Toggle animated scrolling number transition for pageview count.

showSparkline.description: Toggle display of historical pageview trend sparkline chart.

sparklineStyle.description: Visual styling palette and appearance parameters for sparkline chart. Encoded as style query parameter in data:statsUrl.

timeRange.description: Time window for visitor count aggregation. Encoded as timeRange query parameter in data:statsUrl.

Subscribe.description: Subscription feeds, aggregator reader targets, and platform feed icons.

arrowDropdownImg.description: Static platform image URL for the dropdown chevron arrow.

atomFeedTxt.description: Localized label for direct Atom feed subscription (e.g. 'Posts (Atom)').

feedIconImg.description: Static platform image URL for the standard orange RSS feed icon.

feeds.description: Collection of supported web feed reader targets.

encodedUrl.description: URL-encoded feed endpoint used in reader query parameter strings.

title.description: Display name of the feed reader service (e.g. 'Google', 'Yahoo').

type.description: Identifier code for the feed reader target (e.g. 'GOOGLE', 'YAHOO').

url.description: Direct one-click subscription endpoint targeting that reader service.

imagePathBase.description: Base CDN directory URL containing feed reader brand logos.

title.description: Widget header title (e.g. 'Subscribe To').

isPublic.reason: Legacy visibility flag confirming public blog status. Gadget v1 only; omitted from v2.

Text.description: Rich-text and formatted content gadget displaying user-authored text notes or HTML payload.

content.description: Raw HTML markup, JavaScript snippet, or formatted text payload.

title.description: Optional widget header title configured in UI.

content.description: Text content payload wrapped in CDATA.

TextList.description: Ordered or bulleted plain text item collections.

shownum.description: Maximum items to display (0 or negative indicates no limit / show all).

title.description: Widget header title (defaults to 'List' if omitted).

shownum.description: Maximum number of list items to render (0 indicates display all).

sorting.description: Alphabetical sorting order for list items.

patterns.description: Text entry for list item at zero-based {index} (e.g. item-0, item-1, item-2). Deserialized into the data:items array.

Translate.description: Google Translate drop-down or button integration.

pageLanguage.description: Source language ISO code of the blog (e.g. 'en', 'es', 'fr').

title.description: Widget header title (e.g. 'Translate').

displayMode.description: Visual presentation layout format for Google Translate widget. Mapped in runtime to data:layout.

Wikipedia.description: Wikipedia search box interface messages and encyclopedic query tool.

fetchingErrorMsg.description: Localized error message displayed when Wikipedia API query fails.

moreMsg.description: Localized string for expansion/read more link (e.g. 'More').

noResultsFoundMsg.description: Localized message when query yields zero results (e.g. 'No results found').

searchResultsMsg.description: Localized header for results list (e.g. 'Search Results').

title.description: Widget header title (defaults to 'Wikipedia' if omitted).
